name: jungle_depths_elements_a
prompt:
16-bit pixel art ELEMENT SHEET for a top-down bomberman-style pale-green jungle stage. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows of equal cells, each cell 320 wide x 480 tall, on one flat plain cream background (#F7F1E3). No grid lines, no frames, no labels, no text, no numbers, no watermark, nothing crossing cell boundaries. In every cell the bottom 320x320 square is the prop's footprint: the prop's ground contact is centered horizontally, sits on the bottom edge, and faces the viewer; the prop may grow upward into the extra 160 px above. No ground patch and no shadow under the prop, just flat cream. All props share one scale (one 40x40 footprint = 320x320 px), the same top-left light, same 1px selective dark-green outline, flat cel shading with 2-3 tones, pale-green palette (pale jade stone, soft sage, mint, young leaf green, cream highlights, warm brown bark), medium-soft daylight, crisp chunky pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no drop shadows, no isometric camera.

ROW 1 - four seamless 40x40 floor tiles, each filling its whole 320x320 bottom square edge to edge, viewed straight from above, no border, no outline, no shadow, perfectly tileable: (1) pale jade-green stone pavers with 1px darker grout and a little moss in the cracks; (2) the same pavers crossed by light grass and moss; (3) packed earth with fallen leaves and tiny moss patches; (4) clear shallow water, pale blue-green, soft ripple highlights, tileable.

ROW 2 - four single-cell wall props, 3/4 top-down, base centered on the footprint: (1) young jungle tree with a straight trunk and a round layered leaf canopy; (2) leafy bush with dense rounded leaves; (3) massive ancient tree root, gnarled and mossy, low and wide; (4) cut tree stump with visible growth rings and a little moss.

ROW 3 - four destructible tree-type blocks, a soft candy-like top face about 40x40 plus a short dark front band, base centered: (1) cut-log block with bark sides and ring top; (2) leafy sapling block with a small tree sprouting from the block; (3) bush block with a rounded leafy top; (4) mossy stump block, short and chunky.

ROW 4 - (1) pale green stone block carved with a simple snake-scale diamond relief, special brick; (2) small ancient stone totem with a coiled snake carved on its face, single-cell wall prop; (3) fern clump wall prop with bright green fronds; (4) EMPTY cream cell, no object at all.

RULES: every object isolated and centered in its own cell, nothing overlapping between cells, no floating props, no base offset, no extra props, no characters.
